[醫] 鹽硝, 硝酸鉀餅

n. small genus of perennial mostly Eurasian having terminal spikes of small purplish or white flowers
n. type genus of the Prunellidae
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">法語 prunelle，字面義為“黑刺李”；因深色而得名——另見 prunelle</dd></dl>
pruner: n. 修枝剪刀, 修剪樹枝者

n. a worker who thins out and trims trees and shrubs
n. a long-handled pruning saw with a curved blade at the end and sometimes a clipper; used to prune small trees
pruning:
n. 修剪, 修枝, 剪枝
[計] 修剪

n. something that has been pruned off of a plant
n. the act of trimming a plant
prurience: n. feeling morbid sexual desire or a propensity to lewdness
prurient: a. 好色的, 渴望的
prurigo: n. chronic inflammatory disease of the skin characterized by blister capped papules and intense itching
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新拉丁語，源自拉丁語（發癢、癢），源自 prurire（發癢）——另見 prurient</dd></dl>
pruritic:
a. 癢的
[醫] 瘙癢的, 癢的
pruritus:
n. 瘙癢症
[醫] 瘙癢
n. an intense itching sensation that can have various causes (as by allergies or infection or lymphoma or jaundice etc.)
prutah: n. 普魯特（以色列舊輔幣名）； 普魯特硬幣
<dl class="nd"><dt>詞源</dt><dd class="et">新希伯來語 pĕrūṭāh，源自密西拿希伯來語（小銅錢）</dd></dl>
pry:
n. 槓桿, 窺探, 好奇者
vi. 打聽, 窺探
vt. 撬動, 撬開, 費力得到

v. to move or force, especially in an effort to get something open
v. be nosey

<dl class="nd"><dt>語感</dt><dd>整體中性；「撬開」義字典標為美式為主，英式說 prise</dd><dt>常見搭配</dt><dd>pry open；pry the lid off；pry into my personal life；don't want to pry</dd><dt class="w">注意事項</dt><dd class="w">有「撬開」和「窺探隱私」兩個義項；窺探義常接 into，也可單獨用作不及物動詞</dd></dl>
prying:
n offensive inquisitiveness
v to move or force, especially in an effort to get something open
